title: Israelis, Palestinians, Americans See War in Iran Differently
summary_en: Three-quarters of Israelis say the U.S. made the right decision in attacking Iran, while eight-in-ten Palestinians say the opposite. Americans are more divided.
title_cn: Israelis, Palestinians, Americans See War in Iran Differently
